method.proof_strength: Selected actual source functions, direct caller searches, typed data shapes and current live authority. No build, feature parity, concurrency correctness, visual quality, performance or production acceptance verdict.
source_limits: Module inventory is bounded to Argus/native accessibility/diagnostic owners, selected backend FR/manual endpoints and Palmistry lifecycle/forwarding roots.
Existing test bodies and test-name search results are source navigation only; tests were not run and cannot establish acceptance.
Absence findings state the exact searched roots or selected composition inspected, not whole-product absence.
Comments are interpreted against executable bodies; stale 'design-only', 'deferred' or 'non-blocking' prose does not override actual call wiring.
AccessKit capture is a second egui render pass; this investigation did not perceive a running renderer or screenshot.

authority_obligations.requirement: One typed Studio command authority; structured document reads/diffs/render receipts, dry_run, schema, undo/replay, model API and GUI projections through same StudioDocument promotion authority.
Stable author_id and UI state; per-file CRDT/lease scope, real KernelActor attribution and deterministic promotion; operator/model project/module isolation.
Record actual three-tier posture WIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason or DEFERRED-with-reason. Same-change internal UserManual must include FR/EventLedger and diagnostic linkage; no parallel manual.

Inspect real rendered/AccessKit state; action targets and post-action observations, runtime/renderer error scan, request-level agent_label for clients sharing one binding. Source inspection alone cannot satisfy GUI acceptance.
Widen existing AppCommand into UiDescriptor; one generated ParamSpec. Numeric role/bounds/value/time/keyframe state must match rendered controls.
Observability output is protected content; account/Principal/session/Space/resource scope filtered before display, export, retrieval or transmission.

findings.claim: The live native request supports client_session_id, while current authority names agent_label.
findings.searched: rg agent_label/client_session_id in pinned native mcp root: no agent_label occurrence; client_session_id explicit server branch
findings.implication: Preserve authoritative agent_label obligation and actual wire field; resolve alias/adapter at canonical Argus request parser. Client label is caller-chosen attribution, not security identity.
findings.next_proof: Exact shared-token two-client/reconnect/operator attribution and field-compatibility negative matrix under affected MT.

findings.claim: Current action completion is stronger than visible-change-only acknowledgement.
findings.implication: Reuse completion token machinery and extend capability observers; do not build an independent Studio click receipt system.
findings.constraints: pub(crate) author helpers; bounded context/target/semantic strings; Closed schema rejects unknown fields. Must deliberately externalize narrow contract for modular assets.
findings.next_proof: Receipt ties command/actor/doc/revision/exact semantic transition; normalized numeric and timed property change cannot claim Applied from formatting alone.

findings.claim: Action receipts and screenshot results do not expose full visual causality.
findings.implication: Add canonical visual receipt binding for StudioDocument revision, command/promotion receipt, renderer/frame/view, resource scope and render settings. Current expected_generation is snapshot captured_at_utc, not document version.
findings.next_proof: Concurrent edit/render stale frame counterfactual; before/after exact revision/hash; renderer errors, crop/viewport/color/proxy/time and asset lineage included.

findings.claim: Snapshot is generated by re-running self.ui on a fresh context after projecting selected live state.
findings.implication: Every future shared control/presenter must expose stable IDs and side-effect-free capture behavior. Rendering twice must never emit a second authority command or duplicate diagnostic/job.
findings.next_proof: Actual live vs capture popup/scroll/focus/reading/time/tool/control projection, snapshot side-effect count, and viewport/pixel congruence. No general full egui Memory clone should be assumed.

findings.claim: Per-widget leases and stable participant IDs protect queue admission but do not create per-actor views or authoritative permissions.
findings.searched: No ResourceGrant/Principal/account_id/AccessSpace/ResourceBroker matches in selected mcp/accessibility/command_registry roots.
findings.implication: Reuse Argus targeting/lease path; add explicit actor/view/document/resource scope through canonical kernel broker. Same-document backend proposals need CRDT/promotion checks, independent views must not mutate shared focus/selection.
findings.next_proof: Two actors+operator same and different documents/projects; grant revocation at resolve/enqueue/dispatch/render/export; stale selection/view generation and no cross-scope pixels.

findings.claim: Argus ActionLog currently stamps successful enqueue; inspected stamp body does not attach receipt_id to the log call.
findings.implication: Native in-memory attribution/receipt streams need canonical causal linkage to Studio command/promotion evidence, retaining existing log owner. Do not claim EventLedger mirroring merely because native editor event ingress exists.
findings.next_proof: Cross-link request id/participant/receipt/command event/render receipt and recover/replay after crash; successful enqueue distinguished from applied.

findings.claim: Current AppCommand and UiTreeNode are narrower than Studio's UiDescriptor/ParamSpec obligations.
findings.searched: No UiDescriptor/ParamSpec/ResourceGrant symbol in selected pinned native command registry/accessibility/mcp roots.
findings.implication: Extend the existing command registry and snapshot type; one generated parameter record drives menu/palette/control/accessibility/manual. Create specialized presenters only for genuinely different interaction geometry/domain semantics.
findings.next_proof: Menu/palette/control dispatch same command; exact typed numeric/time/bounds enums; no duplicated range/default/unit literals; stable namespace per doc/view/instance.

findings.claim: EditorSurface callback plumbing exists, while its production registry is initialized empty.
findings.searched: EditorSurface implementations/register calls reviewed in root drill: mock/test consumers only; source comments alone not used to call dispatch inert.
findings.implication: Useful future same-host seam; it is not an already-mounted Studio surface or complete command authority. Register narrow capability presenters after canonical domain contract.
findings.next_proof: Production startup registers each capability once, routes selection/workspace generations/callback after queue acceptance, unregisters on lifecycle and exposes Argus/manual.

findings.claim: LayoutGuard has a real checkpoint/commit/rollback type but no production caller was found in pinned native src search.
findings.searched: rg LayoutGuard::checkpoint under pinned native src returns doc example and cfg(test) implementations only.
findings.implication: Do not claim protected agent layout mutation. Reuse or integrate canonical layout owner with explicit revision/conflict semantics rather than a new Studio layout rollback helper.
findings.next_proof: Operator layout priority, two client mutations, exact checkpoint-generation acceptance, rollback cannot clobber later accepted layout.

findings.claim: DiagnosticsRecorder::record is serialized by a Mutex; its public comment 'Non-blocking' is broader than the implementation.
findings.implication: Removing serialization from the existing SPSC shared-memory writer would invalidate producer safety. Studio realtime/render/audio paths need bounded non-blocking producer admission to one canonical diagnostic owner, not independent SPSC multiwriter access.
findings.next_proof: Adversarial producer concurrency, saturation/drop-count and ordering; callback deadline/jitter; no allocations/locks on realtime callback; valid ring payload under pressure.

findings.claim: Typed diagnostic ring event ABI has integers/enums only and no explicit module/domain/document/Principal fields.
findings.implication: Use registered opaque mechanic IDs/versioned interpretation and scoped retrieval mapping outside the ring payload; keep project content out. Per-crate diagnostic coverage needs an explicit registry, not arbitrary counter conventions.
findings.next_proof: No project/sensitive strings; decode ID/version before rendering; unknown enum behavior; account/resource visibility after recovery and cross-account restart.

findings.claim: Operation watchdog supports optional total-runtime cap in addition to progress-gap deadline; production backend helper enables the cap.
findings.implication: Reuse for Studio operations with meaningful deadlines. A ticking operation is not completion; register hard caps when appropriate and connect cancellation/outcome receipts separately.
findings.next_proof: Healthy ticking, stopped progress, forever-ticking, cancelled, completed-before-stall, resource release and exact warning clearing.

findings.claim: Palmistry child watch queue is bounded but evicts oldest command, and app update drains synchronous control acknowledgements.
findings.detail: MAX_PENDING_CHILD_WATCH_COMMANDS 256; enqueue pop_front at capacity; ack read deadline 900ms; no per-frame drain budget in inspected drain function; failures logged and not requeued.
findings.implication: Under Studio worker volume, silent registration/deregistration loss and UI-frame acknowledgement wait are source risks. Extend current launcher/control owner with explicit admission/backpressure and off-frame ordered drain; no lock removal without ownership proof.
findings.next_proof: Queue full failure receipt, duplicate/coalesced controls, register/deregister causal order, unavailable/hung watcher, bounded frame budget, reconnect and stale child cleanup.

findings.claim: Palmistry production recovery forwarding cannot currently reach a faithful ingestion endpoint.
findings.implication: Per-Studio crate three-tier evidence must report local survivor capture separately from DEFERRED FR forwarding. Future compatible delivery requires faithful schema, authorization and canonical ledger idempotency, not chat-body smuggling.
findings.next_proof: Scoped authenticated survivor route, persisted before forward, exact ack identity, restart/double-drain dedupe; forward network cannot pause freeze poll.

findings.claim: Native manual pane is reusable but currently renders static editor sections separately from backend manual persistence.
findings.implication: Keep one native pane and one content contract. Project/generated shared manual sources into both backend query and operator pane; attach typed command/Argus/three-tier anchors at the same capability record.
findings.next_proof: No-context human/model discoverability, one content hash/version, shipped capability fields/enums exact, stale generated manual rejection, backend-down readable recovery.

findings.claim: Selected backend manual routes expose bootstrap header identity/read receipts and a resync actor-kind header gate, unlike inspected FR broker middleware.
findings.implication: This is a precise unresolved authorization seam, not an asserted exploit. Do not copy header-derived identity gate into Studio authority or assume all backend manual content is resource-authorized.
findings.next_proof: Inspect outer routing/auth/database permissions before verdict; bootstrap public corpus separated from protected project examples/receipts; signed session-derived resync authority and revocation cases.

findings.claim: Native editor Flight Recorder reconciliation is actually registered by the routes owner.
findings.implication: Earlier root-drill recovery uncertainty can be narrowed: actual source startup spawns the loop when Tokio handle exists and authorizes each workspace. Crash/durability/idempotency runtime proof remains outstanding.
findings.next_proof: Restart with pending write, poison rows beyond100, denied workspace, matching/conflicting FR row, durable completion and no starvation.

next_proof_requirements.requirement: Bind affected command/control/domain to current HBR family applicability and explicit three-tier posture; run required proof for that MT before accepting it. This source research does not mark HBR PASS.

Separate compile proof for pure contracts/engines/UI adapters and full host integration; no hidden core/runtime-full dependency. Assets harness must exercise genuine controls and APIs, retain future kernel ports.
Bounded admission per actor/document/capability, fairness, queue pressure receipt, cancellation/resource return, deterministic CRDT proposals/promotions; argue ownership before changing locks.

Exact model-command request -> authority revision/diff -> render receipt/pixels -> Argus current view/tree; inspect actual artifacts and runtime errors. Same document parallel actors and stale output negative cases.

Producer fan-in is safe under pressure; heartbeat independent; worker-progress/freeze/crash survive parent; no scoped content leak; faithful forwarding remains explicitly deferred until actual canonical endpoint/recovery proof.

execution_notes.cause: A Windows rg path-glob/interoperability.rs probe referenced nonexistent paths; corrected with rg --files and inspected actual interop/ directory. No source edits or expensive run.
Three tool orchestration inputs had an accidental unmatched quote around max_output_tokens; rejected before shell execution and reissued with valid JavaScript. No external side effect.

An initial diag-ring read used an unverified guessed package path and produced null indexing diagnostics; corrected from previously verified manifest inventory to handshake_native/diag_ring; subsequent probes fail-closed with ErrorActionPreference Stop.
One Argus protocol probe ran in product tree compatibility .GOV; direct live-kernel protocol was then read in full and exclusively cited as authority. No decision relies on copied product governance.
